references.text: The same principle of a holy assembly and prohibition of work during the Feast of Unleavened Bread
Similar command regarding a holy assembly and rest from work during the Feast of Tabernacles
Holy assembly and prohibition of work mentioned in connection with the Passover feast
Parallel text about the Feast of Weeks (shavuot) with a holy assembly and prohibition of work
The expression 'an eternal statute throughout their settlements' is also used here in the same chapter
The same formulation 'an eternal statute for all their generations' used concerning the Day of Atonement
The Feast of Weeks (shavuot) described with joy and gathering before the Lord
Pentecost (shavuot), when the disciples were gathered, fulfillment of this feast in the New Testament
Paul wished to be in Jerusalem for Pentecost, showing the continued significance of the feast
